title: 第7章 秦兰: “你怎么知道我弟弟写了首歌？”-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》
content:
第(1/3)页

    熊乃瑾：“不说别的，什么时候带出来见见？姐姐我好给他说说圈子里的规矩。”

    李小鹿：“呸，你那是想教规矩，而不是馋人家身子？”

    熊乃瑾：“李小鹿！！你再讲下去...我....”

    魏沐看了一会，没眼再看。

    谁说女人不会开车？

    这群里一个个黄段子讲的比男生还暴力.....

    看着群里聊的热火朝天，魏沐主动避让，在一边默默吃菜。

    没一会，秦兰放下手机，嘴角情不自禁的弯起。

    “姐。是不是有人要包养我？”

    秦兰白了他一眼:“瞅你那点出息，你有这写歌本事，还要别人包养？”

    刚才被对方看到群里的消息，秦兰心里都要抠出三室一厅了。

    她在这位弟弟心目中的形象一直都是知性大姐姐，而现在.....

    有一说一，群里喜欢聊黄段子，不是她的问题！

    更不是她引起的！！

    而是霍斯燕和李小鹿那俩骚蹄子，绝对跟我没有一点关系。

    当然了，她不能解释，这种越描越黑的事情用不着解释。

    想到这里，秦兰轻咳两声，马上转移话题道：“刚才我就说了，姐是在给你刷脸。”

    “你也看到了，群里都是演员。李小鹿你知道吧？金马影后，又是大院出来的，手上资源不少。还有霍斯燕、熊乃瑾，她们手上或多或少都有些资源，你在她们面前混个脸熟，以后有什么角色都能想起你！！”

    混个脸熟？不如睡了她们更好。

    魏沐的想法更加简单粗暴，不过他很快打消了这个念头。

    毕竟有秦兰这个姐姐杵在这，他要是敢动这姐姐的“好闺蜜”，以后不知道怎么数落他。

    “你这几天就在魔都呆着，我会派人把香港的事情处理好，然后再录歌，搞完这些，姐姐再带你去京城见她们。”

    秦兰的动作很快，两人分别第二天，便有两个律师联系他。

    这两位都是专业人士，在了解事情真相以后，很快开始搜集材料。

    比如之前和那位制片人的聊天记录，以及签署的那份合同。

    同时，魏沐在离开香港之前，在剧组取材的一些证据起到了关键作用。

    有了这些材料，至少能在谈判过程中占据上风。

    做好前置准备，两位律师直接飞往香港，而魏沐只需要等着事情解决。

    在接下来的几天时间里，魏沐没有闲着，姐姐从京城薅过来一位音乐制作人，帮他制作第一首歌曲。

    ........

    魔都，JA区某间小资情调的咖啡馆里，高小松一边不耐烦地喝着咖啡，一边打量门口的情况。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Xiong Naijin: "If nothing else, when will you bring him out for a meeting? Sister, I can tell him the rules of the circle."

Li Xiaolu: "Bah, are you trying to teach me the rules instead of lusting after someone else's body?"

Xiong Naijin: "Li Xiaolu!! If you keep talking...I..."

Wei Mu looked at it for a while and then looked at it again.

Who says women can’t drive?

​​The pornographic jokes in this group are more violent than those of the boys...

Seeing the lively chat in the group, Wei Mu took the initiative to avoid it and ate in silence.

After a while, Qin Lan put down the phone and couldn't help but curl up the corners of his mouth.

"Sister. Is there someone who wants to support me?"

Qin Lan rolled her eyes at him: "Looking at your potential, you have this ability to write songs, and you still need someone else to support you?"

When the other party saw the news in the group just now, Qin Lan felt like he had three rooms and one living room in his heart.

“Her image in this younger brother’s mind has always been that of an intellectual big sister, but now...

It’s not her problem that the group likes to talk about pornographic jokes!

It was not caused by her!!

“But Huo Siyan and Li Xiaolu, those two coquettish people, have absolutely nothing to do with me.

Of course, she can't explain it. There is no need to explain such things that are getting darker and darker.

Thinking of this, Qin Lan coughed twice and immediately changed the subject and said: "I just said that I was just brushing your face."

"You have also seen that the group is all actors. You know Li Xiaolu, right? The Golden Horse Best Actress came from a large courtyard and has a lot of resources. There are also Huo Siyan and Xiong Naijin. They have more or less resources. If you become familiar with them, they will think of you in any role in the future!!"

Does he look familiar?It would be better to sleep with them.

Wei Mu’s idea was more simple and crude, but he quickly gave up the idea.

“After all, there is a sister like Qin Lan here. If he dares to touch this sister’s “best friend”, I don’t know how to scold him in the future.

"You stay in Shanghai for the next few days. I will send people to take care of things in Hong Kong, and then record the songs. After finishing these, my sister will take you to the capital to meet them."

Qin Lan acted quickly. The day after the two separated, two lawyers contacted him.

Both of them are professionals. After learning the truth of the matter, they quickly began to collect materials.

For example, the chat history with the producer and the contract signed.

At the same time, some evidence that Wei Mu collected from the crew before leaving Hong Kong played a key role.

With these materials, you can at least have the upper hand during the negotiation process.

After making preparations, the two lawyers flew directly to Hong Kong, while Wei Mu only had to wait for the matter to be resolved.

In the next few days, Wei Mu was not idle. His sister brought a music producer from the capital to help him produce his first song.

........

In a bourgeois-style cafe in the JA district of Shanghai, Gao Xiaosong impatiently drank coffee and looked at the situation at the door.
